scientific_integrity: Analytic finite-dimensional construction with exact character polynomial and EPR formula. Symbolic and finite numerical checks supplement but do not replace the proof. No independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite irreducible three-state jump generators with positive rates; this is spectral, stationary-population, and scalar-activity nonidentifiability, not generator or full transition-kernel nonidentifiability.
The upper dissipation range requires a reverse rate to approach zero, without ever equalling zero for a finite target.
A strictly positive, uniform lower bound on all individual rates is not imposed.
The comparison with broader rate-matrix inverse-spectral work remains a residual originality risk.
title: Isospectral three-state cycles with unbounded stationary dissipation at fixed activity
